rationale: Same pin, no upstream change. Delivery adds task tier routing: optional plan task fields tier, reviewer_tier and risk (run_engine.routing_fields: tier 1 to 3, reviewer not below the tier and at least 2 for tier 1, risk tags from skills/delivery/routing.json, tier 1 without risky tags; a null reviewer_tier means the default), per-task implementer and reviewer models in workflow_steps.py args (task_routing: tier model, reviewer tier default 3, adversary on another model for a risky tag, security lens for security; --model and --review-model override; untiered tasks keep model None), relay steps on the table's utility model, and workflow_steps.py path, which sends a Small run with at most two independent open tasks without a risky tag to the native-agent path. Docs (SKILL.md, host-execution.md, run-contract.md, PROVENANCE.md, README.md) replace the rule that implementers and reviewers inherit the configured model; the coordinator and untiered tasks still inherit it. The spec-derived planning, approval and verification rules are unchanged; routing fields are optional and do not enter the spec artifacts.
